createContact.description: Create a new contact with email and contact fields from your Systeme.io account, with optional tags

auth.description: Your Systeme.io API key. You can find this in your Systeme.io dashboard under Profile Settings > Public API Keys.

dynamicContactFields.description: Set contact fields from your Systeme.io account

customFields.description: Add custom contact field values (e.g., country, company, etc.)

field.description: Enter the field slug (e.g., country, company, custom1)

auth.description: Your Systeme.io API key. You can find this in your Systeme.io dashboard under Profile Settings > Public API Keys.

newTagNames.description: Enter names for new tags to create and assign (only used when "Create New Tags" is selected)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new contact in Systeme.io from an email plus optional locale and contact/custom fields, and can optionally tag it. Tags are controlled by a tag-source mode: none, assign existing tags by id, or create-and-assign new tags by name. Use to add someone to the CRM; each call creates a new contact and is not idempotent (repeating may produce duplicates or re-create tags). Requires an email.

addTagToContact.name: addTagToContact
addTagToContact.description: Assign a tag to an existing contact - select an existing tag or create a new one

auth.description: Your Systeme.io API key. You can find this in your Systeme.io dashboard under Profile Settings > Public API Keys.

tagSource.description: Choose whether to use an existing tag or create a new one

auth.description: Your Systeme.io API key. You can find this in your Systeme.io dashboard under Profile Settings > Public API Keys.

newTagName.description: Enter the name for the new tag (only used when "Create New Tag" is selected)

aiMetadata.description: Assigns a tag to an existing Systeme.io contact, identified by contact id. Operates in two modes: reference an existing tag by id, or create a brand-new tag by name and then assign it. Use to label or segment a known contact; assigning an existing tag is effectively idempotent, but the create-new-tag mode creates a fresh tag on each call, so this is not idempotent overall.

removeTagFromContact.name: removeTagFromContact
removeTagFromContact.description: Remove a tag that is currently assigned to an existing contact

auth.description: Your Systeme.io API key. You can find this in your Systeme.io dashboard under Profile Settings > Public API Keys.
Your Systeme.io API key. You can find this in your Systeme.io dashboard under Profile Settings > Public API Keys.

tagId.description: Select a tag currently assigned to this contact

aiMetadata.description: Removes a tag from an existing Systeme.io contact, given the contact id and the tag id to unassign. Use to unlabel or de-segment a contact. Idempotent: once the tag is removed, repeating the call leaves the contact in the same state.

findContactByEmail.name: findContactByEmail
findContactByEmail.description: Locate an existing contact by email address

email.description: The email address to search for

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single Systeme.io contact by exact email address by paging through all contacts and matching case-insensitively. Use to resolve an email to a contact record (e.g. to get its id before tagging or updating). Read-only and idempotent; returns a not-found result if no contact matches.

updateContact.name: updateContact
updateContact.description: Update fields (name, phone, custom fields) of an existing contact using fields from your Systeme.io account

auth.description: Your Systeme.io API key. You can find this in your Systeme.io dashboard under Profile Settings > Public API Keys.
Your Systeme.io API key. You can find this in your Systeme.io dashboard under Profile Settings > Public API Keys.

dynamicContactFields.description: Select which contact fields to update

customFields.description: Add or update custom fields with manual slug entry (use empty value to clear field)

fieldSlug.description: The unique identifier for this field (e.g., custom_field_1, my_field)

fieldValue.description: The value for this field (leave empty to clear the field)

aiMetadata.description: Updates fields of an existing Systeme.io contact, identified by contact id, via a partial merge-patch of standard, account-defined, and manually-keyed custom fields (an empty value clears a field). Use to change a known contact's data such as name, phone, or custom attributes. Idempotent: applying the same field values yields the same result; only the provided fields are touched, and a call with no fields makes no change.

newContact.name: newContact
newContact.description: Fires when a new contact is created

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new contact is created in the Systeme.io account, delivering the new contact record (email, fields, tags). Use to react to newly captured leads or subscribers.

newSale.name: newSale
newSale.description: Fires when a new purchase is made within a funnel

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new sale (purchase) is completed within a Systeme.io funnel, delivering the sale record including amount, product, funnel, contact, and payment details. Use to react to new orders or revenue events.

newTagAddedToContact.name: newTagAddedToContact
newTagAddedToContact.description: Fires when a specific tag is assigned to a contact

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a tag is added to a contact in Systeme.io, delivering the affected contact, the tag that was added, and when it was added. Use to react to a contact being labeled or entering a tag-based segment.
